findings.evidence: The carrier is `{v | ∀ i, mfderiv I I (Φ i) p v = v}`; the two invariants proofs are `rw [mem_invariants_tangentRepresentation_iff...]` plus `funext (hΨ _)`, with no use of the metric.
findings.fix: Define `fixedTangentSubspace` for a family `Φ : ι → M → M` (outside the `RiemannianIsometry` namespace), state the invariants lemmas for `fun g ↦ (g • · : M → M)` with no `Ψ`/`hΨ`, and keep isometry hypotheses only on the exp, geodesic and stratum theorems.
findings.issue: `fixedTangentSubspace` (with `mem_`/`coe_fixedTangentSubspace`, `fixedTangentSubspace_stabilizer_eq_invariants`, `fixedTangentSubspace_eq_invariants`) takes `Φ : ι → RiemannianIsometry I I M M`, but the carrier and proofs only use the coercion `⇑(Φ i)` and `mfderiv`; the invariants lemmas need an isometry-valued `Ψ`/`hΨ` just to rewrite `Ψ g` as `g • ·`.

findings.evidence: `tangentRepresentation` (GroupAction/TangentRepresentation.lean:90) only needs `MDifferentiableAt` of each `g • ·`, which follows from `ContMDiffConstSMul I ∞` because `∞ ≥ 1`.
findings.fix: Drop `hd`; build the differentiability proof from `ContMDiffConstSMul` (via an `abbrev` or a lemma) and pass it to `tangentRepresentation` inside the statements.
findings.issue: The `Strata` section variable `hd : ∀ x, ∀ k ∈ stabilizer K x, MDifferentiableAt I I (k • ·) x` (also used by the private `setOf_mem_iInter_fixedPoints_constSMul_finrank`) can be derived from the ambient `[ContMDiffConstSMul I ∞ K M]`, so `isLocallyConstant_finrank_invariants_tangentRepresentation`, `isClosed_fixedPoints_finrank` and `exists_isManifold_fixedPoints_finrank` take a hypothesis the instance already supplies.

summary: The fixed tangent subspace and its invariants lemmas require Riemannian isometries although they only use the underlying maps, and the group stratum theorems take a differentiability hypothesis that the ambient `ContMDiffConstSMul` instance already implies.
